metadata.title: अपने ही देश में शरणार्थी ब्रू यानि रियांग जनजाति | Bru conundrum and Tripura politics
metadata.description: Tripura will vote for a news assembly on 16 February 2023. In this election many issues including the development of tribal areas is discussed. But the rehabilitation of Bru tribe is not getting attention of the political parties. This tribe is fighting for it's right for more than 2 decades.
